summary: Information disclosure via phpinfo.php, setup.php, ids_log.php, view_source.php
body:
## Information Disclosure Endpoints

1. **/phpinfo.php** - Full PHP configuration (PHP 7.0.30, Linux x86_64, Apache 2.0 Handler)
2. **/setup.php** - DB creds, paths, PHP settings, writable directories
3. **/ids_log.php** - PHPIDS log viewer (writable at /var/www/html/external/phpids/0.6/lib/IDS/tmp/phpids_log.txt)
4. **/vulnerabilities/view_source.php?id=...&security=...** - Source code disclosure for each module
5. **/vulnerabilities/view_source_all.php?id=...** - All levels source
6. **/robots.txt** - Disallow: /
